Document: # Rule 3.6 Stay within your job or role. Retain reasonable knowledge, abilities, and skills according to your job and your characters' backstories. - Do not use knowledge acquired through out-of-character means while you are in-character. This is commonly referred to as "metagaming". - Unless your character has a past in a particular line of work (whether it be backstory or in-game experience), they should not be capable of doing jobs outside of their own. - Do not do other peoples' jobs; you should only play the role you signed up for. If you would like to work a different job, ask the Head of Personnel for a job change. - Exceptions may be made for if no active staff exist for a department, assuming your character has sufficient knowledge. - Standard crew should not be knowledgeable of most non-NT technology unless they've experienced it in-character. Security and command may have some leeway, as long as it is kept within reason. Character backstory may also influence this.
